assistant: Friday Night Lights is an American drama television series about a high school football team in the fictional town of Dillon, Texas. It was based on the 1990 nonfiction book by H.G. Bissinger, A Town , a Team , and a Dream, adapted as the 2004 film of the same name. The series' primary setting, Dillon, is a small, close-knit community in rural Texas. Team coach Eric Taylor (Kyle Chandler) and his family, wife Tami (a guidance counselor turned principal), Julie, and Grace, are featured. The show uses this small-town backdrop to address many issues facing contemporary American culture, including family values and lack of economic opportunities.
user: What about Game of Thrones?
assistant: Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series. It is based on A Song of Ice and Fire, George R.R. Martin's series of fantasy novels, the first of which is A Game of Thrones. It premiered on HBO in the United States on April 17, 2011. The series will conclude with its eighth season in 2019.
The story is set in the fictional Seven Kingdoms of Westeros and the continent of Essos. It chronicles the violent dynastic struggles among the realm's noble families for the Iron Throne, while other families fight for independence from it. The series opens with additional threats in the icy North and Essos in the east.
Like the novel, season 2 follows the dramatic death of Lord Eddard "Ned" Stark, with all of the Starks being separated across Westeros. The season mainly centers around the war of the five kings, fought between the leaders of Westerosi factions who are either staking a claim on the Iron Throne or seeking independence from it.
The next season follows the climactic battle at Kings Landing. Like the previous seasons, it mainly centers around the war of the five kings; after the death of Renly Baratheon, all four kings in Westeros believe to have a claim to the Iron Throne, besides Robb Stark, who seeks vengeance for the death of his father, Lord Eddard "Ned" Stark.
